description: An oil-style painting of a rainy scene. In the foreground a dark wooden desk holds a quill and inkwell, handwritten papers, and a brass telegraph key beside a brass paper-tape machine whose tape spills off the desk. Through a rain-streaked window, a large crowd of people under dark umbrellas fills the middle ground, facing a neoclassical building with columns, a balcony and stairs, where a small group of figures stands. The sky is grey and overcast, with bare trees at left. No legible text is visible.
